parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data catalog.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the tenant ID, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise get-data-lake-database --data-region cn-hangzhou --catalog-name hive --name default --tid 3 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise GetDataLakeDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --WorkspaceId 120000 --CatalogName hive --Tid 3 --DataRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --Name default
